features.feature_value: Used perceived intent/offense and whether it attacked an individual or group; reported being more lenient with political figures.
features.evidence_span: "how offended I was by the intent" ... "whether or not it attacked an individual or group" ... "more lenient with political figures"
features.rationale: The participant explicitly lists multiple criteria they applied when deciding.

features.feature_value: Removed posts perceived as hateful toward immigrants, saying they shouldn't be seen even if another post contradicted it.
features.evidence_span: "The ones that were hateful towards immigrants should not be allowed" ... "Even if there was another post" ... "should not be seen by anyone"
features.rationale: They directly connect immigrant-hate content with the removal decision and mention the pair didn't change that.

features.feature_value: Would not allow posts that used offensive language, including swearing.
features.evidence_span: "didn't want to allow anything that used offensive language including swearing"
features.rationale: They clearly state a language-based threshold driving keep/remove choices.

features.feature_value: Treated vulgar language as a reason to be influenced (implied toward removal).
features.rationale: Although brief, it directly ties the criterion to their decision process.

features.feature_value: Stated they support free speech and felt pained about keeping both, yet removed only items they saw as borderline unhinged with foul/disturbing language.
features.evidence_span: "support freedom of speech" ... "pained me" ... "hit \"keep both\"" ... "only voted to remove" ... "borderline unhinged"
features.rationale: They describe their approach and how their judgment differed from the baseline free-speech stance.

features.feature_value: Looked for threats of violence and used that as a reason to limit speech; if none, they avoided restricting.
features.evidence_span: "didn't see anything (such as threats of violence)" ... "necessitated limiting freedom of speech"
features.rationale: They present an explicit conditional rule centered on violence threats.

features.feature_value: Claimed objectivity and said removed items sounded like gibberish to them.
features.rationale: They attribute their decision (removals) to perceived incoherence/gibberish.
